inputs: canonical locations and directed connectivity relationships
one facility-slot capacity account per asset/scope/period
procedure: Validate asset/account uniqueness, location/connectivity relationships, scope, period and identical slot units. Require explicit directed simple paths to remote connected facilities. Block disconnected or nonoperating inputs. Withhold all competitors on unknown access/availability/procedure. Allocate each facility claim with one shared capacity requirement per path link through the existing allocator. Retain prior postings, holds, topology and additional/unmet quantities without committing state.
independent_oracle: Exhaust 81 combinations of zero through two school, clinic, bridge and road slots. Independently enumerate integer pairs bounded by each facility and by both shared links; explicit school-first priority chooses lexicographic maximum.
interfaces: actual DOM-06/07 readers of staged facility commitments
limits: No service delivery or population coverage
No housing, freight or bandwidth model
No operating labor/energy/land or authority mechanism
No construction, commissioning, maintenance, repair or lifecycle transition
Prior commitments do not prove prior reach or refund on changed declarations
Consumers retain canonical postings and explicitly close the completed phase
No model activation, numerical IPC or parent/cumulative acceptance
review_route: SV separate author inspection; independent agent review deferred
